problem: Lack of automated toll fare aggregation via Fastag API and dynamic fuel cost splitting based on vehicle mileage and passenger count within the budget management module.
root_cause: Budget services currently rely on static or manually entered estimates for travel expenses without integrating external toll calculators or dynamic fuel price and mileage metrics.
architecture: Backend services integrate a Fastag toll calculation API client and a real-time fuel price provider service to compute total route transit costs. The computed breakdown (fuel split per passenger + toll totals) is exposed via REST endpoints and rendered interactively in the mobile frontend budget screen.
recommended_solution: Implement backend services in backend/src/services/fuelPriceProvider.js for fetching real-time fuel prices and backend/src/services/budgetService.js for splitting costs and querying Fastag toll APIs. Update mobile/lib/screens/budget_screen.dart to display the detailed cost breakdown per passenger dynamically.
risks: Fastag API rate limits or downtime causing calculation failures.
Discrepancies in vehicle mileage metrics provided by users.
Network latency during multi-passenger split calculations.
acceptance_criteria: Accurately fetch real-time fuel rates and compute total fuel consumption based on distance and mileage.
Integrate Fastag API to aggregate accurate toll plaza fares along the planned route.
Split total calculated expenses (fuel + tolls) proportionally among registered passengers.
Display the dynamic fuel split and toll breakdown clearly in the mobile budget screen.

test_cases.name: test_fuel_cost_calculation
test_cases.description: Verify fuel cost is correctly calculated using distance, vehicle mileage, and real-time fuel prices.

test_cases.name: test_fastag_toll_aggregation
test_cases.description: Ensure the Fastag API integration returns correct toll plaza fares for a given route polyline.

test_cases.name: test_budget_splitting_logic
test_cases.description: Verify costs are accurately split among the specified number of passengers.

test_cases.name: test_budget_screen_ui_rendering
test_cases.description: Verify the mobile budget screen properly displays dynamic fuel splits and toll totals.
